title: BTS Busan ARIRANG World Tour Shows Sell Out in Fan Presale — First Return to Busan in 3.5 Years
detail: On April 30, 2026, tickets for BTS's ARIRANG World Tour shows at Busan Asiad Main Stadium (June 12–13, 2026) sell out entirely during the official fan club presale via NOL Ticket. The sellout marks BTS's first return to Busan as a full group since their landmark 2022 'BTS: Yet to Come in Busan' concert in October 2022 — a gap of approximately three years and eight months. The June 13 date holds special significance: it is BTS's 13th debut anniversary (June 13, 2013). The Busan run is part of the ARIRANG World Tour's Asia leg following the North American dates, and the rapid sellout underscores continued demand even as the group is mid-tour in the United States. General on-sale dates have not yet been announced; the presale covered official ARMY membership holders. The shows will take place at the same 53,000-capacity Asiad Main Stadium where BTS drew massive crowds in 2022, this time as part of the group's fully reunited post-military-service comeback.

media.caption: BTS's Busan ARIRANG World Tour shows on June 12–13 sell out in the fan presale, marking the group's first return to the city since October 2022

title: V Shares Exclusive Backstage Photos from Florida ARIRANG Tour Leg
detail: On April 30, 2026, V (Kim Tae-hyung) posts exclusive backstage group photos from BTS's Tampa, Florida shows on social media with the caption '대기 시간을 보내는 방법 (How to pass the waiting time).' The photos offer a rare behind-the-scenes look at the ARIRANG World Tour's Florida leg, showing the members in candid moments during the extended pre-show wait periods common in large stadium productions. The post generates immediate traction across ARMY social media communities worldwide, with fans noting the group's relaxed camaraderie and V's characteristic approach to sharing personal content. The Florida run (April 25–28 at Raymond James Stadium) drew approximately 190,000 fans across three sold-out nights and concluded as the tour's North American leg prepares for its next stop in El Paso (May 2–3). The backstage release is part of the group's broader effort to maintain direct ARMY engagement between tour dates through social media, a practice they established during their pre-hiatus tours.

media.caption: V shares candid backstage photos from the BTS ARIRANG World Tour Florida leg with the caption 'How to pass the waiting time'
